title: Mail templates cannot format an amount in the record's currency: `currency:ARG` takes only a literal ISO code, and a path argument silently renders USD
body:
Found by the hotclm app (objectstack-ai/hotclm#179, PR #182), measured with `EmailService.renderTemplate` from `@objectstack/plugin-email@18.2.0`.

## (b) A mail template cannot format an amount in the record's own currency

An app that sends one notice for every contract, such as "instalment overdue", has amounts in many currencies. The record carries the code (`currency_code`). The `currency` hole formatter takes its ISO code only as a literal argument in the template (`{{ amount | currency:CNY }}`, which defaults to USD). So one bundle can only show bare numbers, or hard-code one currency for every record.

Seam: spec `email_template` hole formatter `currency:ARG` → plugin-email `template-engine` `render()` → `@objectstack/formula` `formatValue` `FORMATTERS.currency`. The engine's own comment says it reuses `formatValue` "so dates, money … render identically to in-app templates", but the in-app renderer formats a currency field with its record's code.

Expected: a template can name the code from the data. For example, the argument resolves a template variable (`currency:currency_code`), or `templateData` passes a value the formatter already knows the code of.

## (c) A path argument falls back to USD silently, and the gates pass it

`{{ planned_amount | currency:currency_code }}` passes `os validate` and `os lint` (exit 0). At render time, with `currency_code = 'eur'`, it renders `US$1,234.50` (zh-CN), `$1,234.50` (en) and `1 234,50 $US` (fr-FR): the Intl `RangeError` is caught and USD is used. An author who reaches for the path form gets the wrong currency, with no refusal anywhere.

Expected: either the argument resolves (b), or validate refuses a non-ISO literal and the renderer does not silently substitute USD.

## Measured

`currency:CNY` renders `¥1,234.50` in zh-CN (correct). `currency:currency_code` with data `eur` renders USD in all three locales (above). Probe script and output: hotclm PR #182 body.

Dedupe: searched currency formatter / email template / per-record code / silent USD; closest are #8345 (exchange rates, a different subject) and #22727 (formula currency return type, closed).
